name: What is the difference between repairing and replacing a hail-damaged roof?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between repairing and replacing a hail-damaged roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair or replace a hail-damaged roof depends on the extent and severity of the damage. Minor, localized damage might be repairable by replacing a few shingles. However, widespread damage, especially if it affects the roof's integrity or lifespan, usually necessitates a full replacement. Our assessment will detail the damage extent, helping you understand the most cost-effective and structurally sound solution for your specific roof's condition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair is for minor, localized damage, while replacement is needed for widespread or severe damage affecting the roof's integrity. An assessment will determine the best option.
